doi.description:
DOI direct lookup. Skips keyword search and returns the single publication matching the DOI.
Format: standard DOI, e.g., 10.1145/3292500.3330701
When doi is provided, query may be empty and other filter parameters are ignored.

min_citations.description: Minimum citation count, non-negative integer string, e.g., `100`. Used for academic quality filtering. Maps to `minCitationCount` parameter.

open_access.description:
Whether to return only open access publications.
Valid values: true / false

sort.description: Sort field. Valid values: `cited_by_count`, `publication_date`, `publication_year`, `relevance_score`, `display_name`. Append `:asc` or `:desc` to specify direction, e.g., `cited_by_count:desc`. Default: sort by relevance.

type.description: 1. Document type filter. Valid values: `article`, `book`, `book-chapter`, `dataset`, `dissertation`, `preprint`, `report`, `review`, `other`. 2. Publication type, comma-separated multi-value (no spaces). Valid values (13): `JournalArticle`, `Conference`, `Review`, `CaseReport`, `ClinicalTrial`, `Dataset`, `Editorial`, `LettersAndComments`, `MetaAnalysis`, `News`, `Study`, `Book`, `BookSection`.

venue.description: Journal/conference name, comma-separated multi-value. Must match S2 database exactly. Common values: `NeurIPS`, `ICML`, `ICLR`, `CVPR`, `Nature`, `Science`, `Cell`, `Lancet`. Maps to `venue` parameter.

year_from.description:
Publication year start (inclusive), four digits.
Example: 2020

year_to.description:
Publication year end (inclusive), four digits.
Example: 2024
For single-year queries, set year_from and year_to to the same value.

category.description: Subject category, comma-separated multi-value. filter.description: RAMOSE filter expression. Format: `field:value`, e.g., `creation:2020-*-*` (citations after 2020).

id.description: Persistent identifier value extracted from user input. Do NOT include type prefixes like "doi:" or "pmid:". Formats: DOI (e.g. 10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2), PMID (pure digits, e.g. 33817056), ISSN (e.g. 0138-9130), ISBN (e.g. 9781402096327), ORCID (e.g. 0000-0003-0530-4305), OMID (e.g. br/06101801781), OCI (digits-digits, e.g. 06101801781-06180334099, only for op=citation).

id_type.description: Identifier type. Values: `doi`, `pmid`, `issn`, `isbn`, `orcid`, `omid`. When empty, auto-detected from query format (e.g., `10.xxx/yyy` → doi, pure digits → pmid).

min_citations.description: Minimum citation count, non-negative integer string, e.g., `100`. Used for academic quality filtering

op.description: Operation type. Values: `metadata` (metadata query, default), `citations` (cited-by list), `references` (reference list), `citation-count` (citation count), `reference-count` (reference count), `author` (works by author), `editor` (works by editor), `venue-citation-count` (journal citation count), `citation` (single citation relationship, requires OCI)

open_access.description: Whether open access. Valid values: true, false

sort.description: RAMOSE sort expression. Format: `field:order`, e.g., `creation:desc` (descending by creation time).

type.description: 1. Document type filter. Values: `journal-article` (journal paper), `book` (book), `proceedings-article` (conference paper), `dataset` (dataset), `book-chapter` (book chapter), `posted-content` (preprint), `report` (report), etc. Maps to Crossref `filter=type:{value}`. 2. sub_domains.description: Court decisions and legal opinions, searchable by keyword, case name, court, date across CN, US, CA and ECHR

case_id.description: CanLII case identifier. Format: 4-digit year + lowercase court code + case number, e.g. `2008scc9` (Dunsmuir v. New Brunswick), `2014onca925`, `1998canlii793`. When provided, the plugin performs an exact case metadata lookup. When empty, falls back to database browsing mode. Do NOT pass natural language queries or keywords — only valid CanLII caseIds.

database_id.description: Target court database code. Examples: `csc-scc` (Supreme Court of Canada), `onca` (Ontario Court of Appeal), `bcca` (BC Court of Appeal), `fca` (Federal Court of Appeal), `qcca` (Quebec Court of Appeal). When empty, uses configured default database list.

doc_type.description: Document type to search. Values: `o` (opinions, default), `r` (RECAP archives), `rd` (RECAP documents), `d` (dockets), `p` (people/judges), `oa` (oral arguments). When empty, defaults to opinions. Alternatively, ECHR document type filter. Values: `JUDGMENTS` (judgments), `DECISIONS` (decisions), `COMMUNICATEDCASES` (communicated cases). When empty, searches all three types.

language.description: API output language. Values: `en` (English, default), `fr` (French). Affects returned case title and URL language version.

respondent.description: Respondent country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format. Examples: `TUR` (Turkey), `FRA` (France), `RUS` (Russia), `GBR` (UK), `DEU` (Germany), `ITA` (Italy), `UKR` (Ukraine). When empty, no country filter.

service.description: Target search service, takes priority over tag-based routing. Values: `case` or `case-search` (semantic case search), `casekw` or `case-keyword` (keyword case search), `law` or `law-search` (statute search). When empty, auto-routed by tags, defaulting to statute search.

sub_domains.description: Legal text lookup for laws, administrative regulations, regulatory rules with article positioning and version history

agency.description: Publishing agency slug identifier. Common values: `environmental-protection-agency` (EPA), `securities-and-exchange-commission` (SEC), `food-and-drug-administration` (FDA), `federal-communications-commission` (FCC), `department-of-energy` (DOE), `department-of-labor` (DOL). When empty, searches all agencies.

collection.description: Document collection code to restrict search. Common values: `FR` (Federal Register), `CFR` (Code of Federal Regulations), `USCODE` (United States Code), `BILLS` (Congressional Bills), `PLAW` (Public and Private Laws), `USCOURTS` (Court Opinions), `CREC` (Congressional Record), `STATUTE` (Statutes at Large). When empty, searches all collections.

date_from.description: 1. Regulation effective date filter, format `YYYY-MM-DD`. Only returns provisions effective on or after this date. Example: `2024-01-01` limits to content effective from 2024 onward. When empty, no date filter. 2. Publication date lower bound, format `YYYY-MM-DD`. Only returns documents published on or after this date. When empty, no lower bound.

date_to.description: Publication date upper bound, format `YYYY-MM-DD`. Only returns documents published on or before this date. Use with `date_from` to define a date range. When empty, no upper bound.

doc_type.description: 1. Document type filter, using EUR-Lex resource-type codes. Values: `REG` (Regulation), `DIR` (Directive), `DEC` (Decision). When empty, searches all types. 2. UK legislation type code, takes priority over type extraction in tags. Values: `ukpga` (UK Public General Acts), `uksi` (UK Statutory Instruments), `asp` (Acts of the Scottish Parliament), `anaw` (Acts of the National Assembly for Wales), `nia` (Northern Ireland Acts), `primary` (all primary legislation), `secondary` (all secondary legislation), `all` (all types). When empty, no type filter. 3. Federal Register document type filter. Values: `RULE` (final rules), `PRORULE` (proposed rules), `NOTICE` (notices), `PRESDOCU` (presidential documents, including executive orders). When empty, searches all types.

historical.description: Whether to include historical version documents. Value: `true` or `false`, default `false`. When `true`, returns historical revision versions of documents.

language.description: Result language, using ISO 639-1 codes. Values: `en` (English, default), `fr` (French), `de` (German), `it` (Italian), `es` (Spanish) and other EU official languages. Affects the title and abstract language of returned documents.

title.description: CFR Title number, to restrict search scope to a specific federal regulation title. Examples: `40` (Environmental Protection), `21` (Food and Drugs), `48` (Federal Acquisition Regulations), `49` (Transportation), `6` (Domestic Security). When empty, searches all Titles.

champion.description: Champion name substring filter. Matches any champion whose name contains the value, e.g., "Lee" matches Lee Sin, "vi" matches Vi and Sivir. If omitted, returns top count champions across all. Used with: mastery. E.g., "Yasuo"

division.description: Subdivision within a tier. Only meaningful when tier is DIAMOND through IRON. Defaults to I if tier is set but division is omitted. Values: `I`, `II`, `III`, `IV`. Used with: leaderboard (requires tier). E.g., "II"

game_name.description: Player's Game ID. Supports two formats: with tagLine embedded via "#" separator (e.g., "Hide on Bush#KR1", region is still required for API routing) or without tagLine (e.g., "Tyler1", default tagLine for that server is inferred automatically from region). Required for: player, ranked, mastery, live_game. E.g., "Faker#KR1"

match_id.description: Fully-qualified match ID. Format: {REGION_PREFIX}_{numeric_id}. The region prefix determines the routing region automatically — no separate region param needed. Required for: match_detail. E.g., "KR_7482819248", "NA1_4912837465", "EUW1_6723541890"

queue.description: Ranked queue type filter. Values: `RANKED_SOLO_5x5` (solo/duo ranked), `RANKED_FLEX_SR` (flex 5v5 ranked). If omitted for player/ranked, returns data across all queues. If omitted for leaderboard, defaults to RANKED_SOLO_5x5. Used with: player, ranked, leaderboard. E.g., "RANKED_SOLO_5x5"

region.description: Server region for API routing. Values: `kr` (Korea), `na` (North America), `euw` (Europe West), `eune` (Europe Nordic & East), `jp` (Japan), `br` (Brazil), `la1` (Latin America North), `la2` (Latin America South), `oc` (Oceania), `tr` (Turkey), `ru` (Russia), `sg`/`sea` (Southeast Asia). Required for: player, ranked, mastery, live_game, leaderboard. Optional for champion_rotation (defaults to na if omitted). E.g., "kr"

tier.description: Ranked tier filter. When omitted, auto-fetches Challenger, Grandmaster, Master by LP. When provided, division may also be specified. Values: `CHALLENGER`, `GRANDMASTER`, `MASTER`, `DIAMOND`, `EMERALD`, `PLATINUM`, `GOLD`, `SILVER`, `BRONZE`, `IRON`. Note: CHALLENGER/GRANDMASTER/MASTER have no divisions — omit division for these tiers. Used with: leaderboard. E.g., "DIAMOND"

type.description: Query category. Determines which API chain is invoked and which other params are required. Values: `player` (match history of last N games + ranked summary), `ranked` (ranked stats only: tier, LP, W/L per queue, no match details), `mastery` (champion mastery list), `live_game` (whether a player is currently in a game; returns game state if so), `match_detail` (full participant breakdown for a single match by ID), `leaderboard` (top-ranked players for a region and queue), `champion` (champion static data: name, title — uses query field for fuzzy search), `item` (item static data: name, cost — uses query field for fuzzy search), `champion_rotation` (current free champion rotation for a platform). E.g., "player"
